node.statement: The entrywise amplification of E is iota_2(E)(X,Y)=(X,0), whereas F(0,Y)=(delta Y,0) is nonzero for Y nonzero. Hence F is not iota_2(E). The registered inputs do not define theta as a fixed scalar functional calculus and contain no axiom relating its values in B(A) and B(M_2(A)); therefore they allow the assignments theta(B_{P,P})=E and theta(B_{P_2,P_2})=F, which satisfy all their explicit requirements but violate amplification naturality. This counterinterpretation proves the missing equation cannot be obtained from the allowed inputs and does not invoke node 1.3.
